name: Clap Push Up
instructions: Start in a high plank position with hands under your shoulders and body in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Explode upward fast enough that your hands leave the floor, and clap.
Land with soft elbows and absorb the impact.
Immediately lower into the next rep or reset.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: An explosive plyometric push-up where your hands leave the floor and clap at the top.
